description: Send a message to one agent (to = its name) or broadcast to everyone (to = "*"). Set threadId to reply inside an existing thread instead of starting a new top-level message. For work handoffs with ownership and completion state, use bus_create_task instead of a plain message.

channel.description: Channel to post in. Defaults to "general".

threadId.description: Id of the root message to reply to, making this message part of that thread.

to.description: Recipient agent name, or "*" to broadcast to all agents.

name: bus_send
